about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply:
If you love gigs and live music, [[Music]] could be a great one to check out. 

Have you had a look at the Societies page to see what else catches your eye?

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: It sounds like you would love a cozy night in. For your interests, you could check out [[Gaming and Roleplay]], [[Book]], and [[Film]]. Have you had a look at your settling-in checklist yet?

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply:
Since you are into football and running, you might like [[Climbing]] or [[Mountaineering]] for keeping active, or [[Walking]] for getting outside. 

Have a look at the Societies page to see all the options available.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: It sounds like you had a lovely, relaxing day. Since you enjoy cinema, you might like [[Film]], which is a special interest society. What kind of films do you usually enjoy watching?

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: For gaming, you might like [[Esports]] or [[Gaming and Roleplay]] to connect with other players. You can also have a look at the Societies page to see everything else available. What kind of games do you usually play with your mates?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: Since you are into big nights out, music and dancing, you might enjoy [[Beats Cartel Dance]] and [[Dance]] for dance styles, or [[Music]] if you are also into performing. Have a look at the Societies page for more ideas that might fit your vibe.

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply:
Since you enjoy hiking and early morning walks, you might like [[Walking]] for outdoor strolls and [[Mountaineering]] for bigger hill trips. 

You can also check out [[Outdoor Climbing]] if you prefer heading outside rather than staying in a gym. Have you had a look at the Societies page to see what else is on offer?

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply:
It sounds like you enjoy creative and outdoor activities. 

You might like [[Hooked By Crochet]] for craft projects, or [[Walking]] if you enjoy getting outdoors. Have a look at the Societies page to browse all the options available.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Thanks for letting me know what you want to avoid. What sort of hobbies or interests do you enjoy in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply:
Since you like reading and quiet nights in, [[Book]] and [[Film]] might be just right for you. 

Have a look at the Societies page for more details, or let me know if you would like any other ideas.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply:
If you enjoy listening to music and going to gigs, you might like [[Music]]. 

What kind of things do you usually like to do with your friends?

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: That sounds like a wonderful way to learn and meet new people. You might like [[Ukrainian]], which is open to everyone interested in the community. Have you had a chance to look at the Societies page to see what else catches your eye?

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: Being a mature student is quite common, and there's a group specifically for you called [[Mature Students]] which is great for meeting others in the same boat. You can also take a look at the Societies page to browse everything else that's on offer. Are there any particular hobbies or interests you enjoy outside of your course?
